name: Platinum Wind ~Hoshi no Uta ga Kikoetara~
original_name: プラチナウインド～星の詩が聞こえたら～
source:
Albeit tiny, the kingdom of Quartet is prosperous thanks to a mysterious magical light (known as "Platina") that envelops the region. In this bustling city, an alchemist returns home after his apprenticeship.

[Edited and translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%97%E3%83%A9%E3%83%81%E3%83%8A%E3%82%A6%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%89]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
四重奏王国虽然面积不大，却因笼罩当地的一种神秘魔法之光“Platina”而繁荣昌盛。在这座熙熙攘攘的城市里，一名炼金术士结束学徒生涯，回到了故乡。

[编辑并翻译自[url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%97%E3%83%A9%E3%83%81%E3%83%8A%E3%82%A6%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%89]Wikipedia[/url]]
